_comment: Auto-extracted trace counts from paper_final/tpcds/Sieve_GNN_executed.ipynb (Phase 5a output cell) and paper_final/tpcds/relationships.csv. Committed so that the qualitative TPC-DS section can quote only numbers backed by an artefact, per the manuscript's data-availability commitment.

recovered_fk_breakdown_by_attribution.interpretation: Every accepted FK row has Reason field name=0.70, meaning the candidate was proposed by Strategy 1 (NameSim) after the prefix-stripping normalisation; none was proposed solely by Strategy 3.

honest_attribution: The recovery from FK F1 0.000 (previous revision) to FK F1 0.271 at perfect precision is attributable to P3 (Kimball IDScore extension: _sk/_nk/_bk/_dk -> IDScore=2) operating through Strategy 1's prefix-stripping NameSim. P2 (the non-circular Strategy-3 weak-label rule) is in the code path and resolves a documented circularity, but on this run the GATv2 edge classifier trains on only 10 weak labels, reaches val F1=0.000, and does not contribute to the 16 accepted FKs.
